title: AES 2025 : Domestic Energy Resilience for Now and the Future
excerpt: Join us at the Annual Energy Symposium (AES) 2025 hosted by SPE Java Indonesia Section as we explore “Domestic Energy Resilience for Now and the Future.”
body:
Energy security isn’t a distant goal, it’s today’s responsibility.

Join us at the Annual Energy Symposium (AES) 2025 hosted by SPE Java Indonesia Section as we explore “Domestic Energy Resilience for Now and the Future.”

AES 2025 brings together thought leaders, engineers, policymakers, and innovators

to challenge assumptions and collaborate on solutions for a resilient domestic energy system.

🗓️ Golf Tournament: 21 June 2025
🗓️ Pre-Event: 23 - 25 June 2025
🗓️ Main Event: 26 June 2025

Let’s define the next chapter of Indonesia’s energy story.
